text:
Mara: Hey @people-ops — quick question. My spouse's H4 EAD still says 'pending' and benefits open enrollment portal is asking for proof to add dependents by 04/15. We filed and received an I-797C on 03/10 (receipt attached). Can People Ops provide a proof-of-filing letter so I can enroll my spouse and child?
Kevin (People Ops): Hi Mara — congrats on the new role! Yes — we can accept the USCIS receipt (I-797C) as provisional proof to enroll dependents for medical/dental/vision. Please DM a scan of the I-797C, spouse passport, and marriage certificate and we'll draft an official letter on letterhead. Also confirm which coverage start date you want (e.g., 04/01).
Mara: Sending scans to you now. Would like coverage effective 04/01 if possible.
upload-bot: mara uploaded files: i797c_mara_spouse_20260310.pdf, marriage_certificate.pdf, passport_spouse.pdf
Kevin (People Ops): Got them. We'll prepare the draft. FYI payroll needs the signed dependent enrollment forms for any pre-tax elections before the effective date; if you want FSA or commuter pre-tax, please complete the enrollment forms.
Ashley (Payroll): @Kevin correct — for payroll and pre-tax elections we need: 1) proof of relationship (marriage cert) and 2) proof that employee is benefits-eligible. For a pending H4 EAD we can provisionally enroll dependents in medical/dental/vision based on the receipt notice, but reimbursements tied to spouse employment may require final EAD. Payroll can set benefits effective 04/01 based on the receipt notice.
Mara: One more Q — if spouse starts working once EAD is approved, can we get childcare reimbursement retroactive to their start date?
Kevin (People Ops): We generally do not issue retroactive childcare reimbursements, but payroll can consider retro pay within the same quarter with proof of EAD and employer start date. Please open a payroll ticket (payroll@redwoodinference.com) and CC me if you'd like us to review a retro request.
Ashley (Payroll): To be clear: retro reimbursements need (a) EAD copy, (b) employer/offer letter showing spouse start date, and (c) receipts. If it's within the same payroll cycle retro pay is more likely; otherwise it becomes manual and taxable.
Jordan (Immigration): Quick note — USCIS processing can vary; if you run into biometrics or RFE delays we can ask counsel to submit an expedite or a request for evidence response. That won't speed routine processing, but useful if there is a legitimate hardship tied to benefits or start date.
Mara: Thanks. Kevin — can you drop the draft letter here so I can review spouse name spelling?
Kevin (People Ops): Draft below (will send on letterhead via email once you confirm). Please reply with spouse full legal name exactly as on passport.
Kevin (People Ops): ```
To Whom It May Concern,

This letter confirms that Redwood Inference has received USCIS Form I-797C (Receipt Number: SRC1234567890) for [Spouse Full Name], filed 03/10/2026, in connection with an H-4 Employment Authorization Document (EAD) application. While the EAD application is pending, Redwood Inference will provisionally enroll dependents for the employee (Mara [LastName]) in the company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans effective 04/01/2026. This provisional enrollment is for benefits-processing purposes only and is contingent on receipt of final USCIS documentation. Certain reimbursements or benefits that specifically require proof of the dependent's work authorization may be withheld until the EAD is issued.

Sincerely,
Kevin 
People Operations
Redwood Inference
```
Mara: Spouse name is "Rohit Sharma" (same as passport). Thanks — please send the signed letter to benefits@redwoodinference.com and payroll.
Kevin (People Ops): Will do. Sending now and cc'ing payroll. Expect confirmation from benefits-team within 24-48 hours.
benefits-team: Confirming receipt — we've put Mara's dependents into 'pending active' for an effective date of 04/01/2026. Enrollment link and steps to complete elections will be sent to Mara's email by EOD. Note: final dependent coverage is subject to provision of the final EAD once issued.
Mara: Amazing, thank you all so much :heart:
Ashley (Payroll): Confirmed — payroll will hold for final EAD for any reimbursements. Reach out if you get the EAD earlier and want to trigger reimbursements.
Kevin (People Ops): Closing loop here — I uploaded the signed letter to Mara's HR file and emailed benefits/payroll. If anything else pops up, DM me. :thumbsup:
